Odoo Maintenance: Property & Unit Dynamic Dropdown

Simple staging guide to add Property Name and Unit Name to Maintenance Requests and filter units by the selected property.

ModuleMaintenance Requests
RelationshipProperty → Property Units
ResultUnit dropdown shows only matching units
Before starting: Do this in the staging/test database first. Existing Property and Unit records are reused; do not create a second Property or Unit model.
1

Confirm the existing Property and Unit records

Open the Properties module and confirm that the property records already exist. Also confirm that each unit already has a specific Property assigned.

Existing Properties list.
Example unit already linked to a specific Property.
Example shown: BTNSHARED-101 is linked to 13 (114-266) AL BUTEEN BUILDING. This existing relationship is what the Maintenance filter will use.
2

Create Property Name on the Maintenance form

Go to Maintenance → Maintenance Requests → New, then open Studio.

  • Drag a Many2One field onto the form.
  • Select the existing Property model.
  • Set the label to Property Name.
  • Enable Disable creation, Disable 'Create', and Disable 'Create and Edit'.
Maintenance Request form before adding the new fields.
Property Name correctly pulls existing Property records.
3

Create Unit Name on the Maintenance form

Add another Many2One field directly below Property Name.

  • For the related model, select Property Units.
  • Set the label to Unit Name.
  • Enable the same no-create options so users only choose existing units.
Choose Property Units as the related model.
Unit Name created with creation disabled.
4

Confirm the technical field names

Developer Mode makes the technical names visible. We confirmed the following:

Maintenance Property Name
x_studio_property_name
Maintenance Unit Name
x_studio_unit_name
Property field inside Property Units
property_id
Studio shows x_studio_property_name.
Export screen confirms the Unit model uses property_id.
5

Open the Studio inherited view

The normal Studio Domain editor rejected the dynamic field reference, so use the Studio inherited XML view instead.

  • Exit Studio.
  • Open a Maintenance Request with Developer Mode enabled.
  • Click the developer/debug icon → Edit View: Form.
  • Open the Inherited Views tab.
  • Open Odoo Studio: equipment.request.form customization.
Developer menu: choose Edit View: Form.
Open the Odoo Studio inherited customization, not the standard base view.
6

Add the dynamic domain to Unit Name

In the Studio inherited view Architecture, keep the Property field unchanged and add the domain only to x_studio_unit_name.

Original Studio Architecture containing the two custom fields.

Replace only the Unit Name line with:

<field name="x_studio_unit_name" domain="[('property_id', '=', x_studio_property_name)]" options="{'no_create':true}"/>

The finished section should be:

<data>
    <xpath expr="//field[@name='equipment_id']" position="after">
        <field name="x_studio_property_name" options="{'no_create':true}"/>
        <field name="x_studio_unit_name" domain="[('property_id', '=', x_studio_property_name)]" options="{'no_create':true}"/>
    </xpath>
</data>
Final XML before clicking Save.
Important: Do not edit the standard/base Maintenance view. Only edit the Odoo Studio inherited customization.
7

Save and test

  • Click Save in the inherited view.
  • Return to Maintenance → Maintenance Requests → New.
  • Select a Property, for example 13 (114-266) AL BUTEEN BUILDING.
  • Open Unit Name.
  • Confirm that only units linked to that Property are available.
  • Change to a second Property and confirm the Unit list changes accordingly.
Expected result: Property Name controls the Unit Name dropdown. Users cannot create new Properties or Units from the Maintenance Request.
8

What this customization affects

✅ Maintenance Request form only
✅ Uses existing Property and Unit records
✅ Property module remains unchanged
✅ Contract module remains unchanged
✅ No records are deleted or rewritten
✅ Unit dropdown is filtered by selected Property
Production recommendation: After the staging test passes, repeat the same field setup and inherited-view change in production, then test again before users start using it.
